title: 推多米诺
summary: 一排多米诺初始可向左、向右受力或竖立，受相反方向同时作用时保持竖立，返回最终状态。
insight: 分别计算每个位置从左侧 R 传播的递减正力和从右侧 L 传播的递减负力；合力符号决定最终方向。
pitfalls: 遇到反向推力会清空当前传播
传播强度每远一格减一
正负力相等时保持点号

solutions.title: 双向传播合力
solutions.idea: 用两次扫描叠加左右方向影响。
steps: 左到右：R 令 force=n，L 令零，点号令 force=max(force-1,0)，加到 forces[i]
右到左对称：L 令 force=n，R 令零，点号衰减，从 forces[i] 减去
forces[i]>0 输出 R，<0 输出 L，否则输出点号

code.java: class Solution { public String pushDominoes(String dominoes){int n=dominoes.length(),force=0;int[] forces=new int[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++){char c=dominoes.charAt(i);force=c=='R'?n:c=='L'?0:Math.max(force-1,0);forces[i]+=force;}force=0;for(int i=n-1;i>=0;i--){char c=dominoes.charAt(i);force=c=='L'?n:c=='R'?0:Math.max(force-1,0);forces[i]-=force;}StringBuilder answer=new StringBuilder();for(int value:forces)answer.append(value>0?'R':value<0?'L':'.');return answer.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun pushDominoes(dominoes:String):String{val n=dominoes.length;val forces=IntArray(n);var force=0;for(i in 0 until n){force=when(dominoes[i]){'R'->n;'L'->0;else->maxOf(force-1,0)};forces[i]+=force};force=0;for(i in n-1 downTo 0){force=when(dominoes[i]){'L'->n;'R'->0;else->maxOf(force-1,0)};forces[i]-=force};return buildString{for(value in forces)append(if(value>0)'R' else if(value<0)'L' else '.')}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string pushDominoes(string dominoes){int n=dominoes.size(),force=0;vector<int> forces(n);for(int i=0;i<n;++i){force=dominoes[i]=='R'?n:dominoes[i]=='L'?0:max(force-1,0);forces[i]+=force;}force=0;for(int i=n-1;i>=0;--i){force=dominoes[i]=='L'?n:dominoes[i]=='R'?0:max(force-1,0);forces[i]-=force;}string answer;for(int value:forces)answer+=value>0?'R':value<0?'L':'.';return answer;} };
